name: button
title: Button
description: Accessible action control with six variants, eight sizes, loading feedback, icon support, and Base UI composition.
author: aq-ui contributors

props.name: className
props.description: Class names or a Base UI state callback composed after aq-ui variants.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the button is busy. Busy buttons are disabled automatically.

props.name: loadingIndicator
props.description: Optional indicator rendered while the button is busy. Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Replaces the visible button content while loading without adding a live region.

props.name: loadingPosition
props.description: Places the loading indicator at the logical start or end of the content.
